verdict.rationale: Snyk's docs describe an LLM-driven Remediation Agent and CLI/PR-based fix workflows that generate, apply and verify fixes with human-in-the-loop review (snyk-docs-12, snyk-docs-13, snyk-docs-21, snyk-docs-29, snyk-docs-30), supporting the story of AI-drafted remediation for review/merge. However, a hands-on community report describes turning off Snyk's automated fix PRs because they created large volumes of low-value or incorrect PRs rather than proper rewrites (snyk-comm-6), directly contradicting the claimed reliability of the PR-drafting workflow. Missing for 10: independent verification specifically of the newer AI Remediation Agent's PR quality (not just the legacy dependency-upgrade PR bot), and clearer evidence of merge-ready PR output rather than in-IDE/CLI-only fixes.
